stem.text: A nucleus collides with a stationary nucleus in a vacuum. The diagrams show the paths of the nuclei before and after the collision.
No other particles are involved in the collision.

A.alt: Diagram of an arrowed horizontal line meeting a point, from which two lines with arrowheads leave, one going up to the right and one going down to the right.

B.alt: Diagram of an arrowed horizontal line meeting a point, from which two lines with arrowheads leave, one going up to the right and one going right and slightly down.

C.alt: Diagram of an arrowed horizontal line meeting a point, from which two lines with arrowheads leave, one going right and slightly down and one going down to the right.

D.alt: Diagram of an arrowed horizontal line meeting a point, from which one line with an arrowhead leaves going up to the right and one line with an arrowhead leaves going down to the left.
